ops.title: Attribute and remove unnecessary CCI daemon CPU work
ops.description:
Owner: cci_grep_hotpath. Root accepted this as a separate actionable investigation after the native tail task completed. Actual installed v0.41.8 daemon PID75436/start1793394448.742058 consumed109.0 percent of one core in a10.009-second native-counter window at14:52PDT, with0.09MiB/s reads. It was below the top14 CPU entries in the14:55 repeat, so sustained load and exact path remain UNKNOWN. Do not attribute it to the repaired tail command.

Next executable step: measure exact same-identity daemon counters, inspect bounded existing daemon.log and live client identities, then trace actual importer/relay/HTTP/SDK request sources. No pprof endpoint exists in current source. macOS sample(1) explicitly suspends the process, so it is excluded under session/service protection; use passive evidence instead. Preserve all agents, MCP, Orca, terminal/supervisor identities, active Git operations, approved Git maintenance, unknown-ownerDU98108, schema14/wire3/fingerprint and installed tail semantics. No signals, restarts, local builds/tests/benchmarks, bulk ledger hashes or arbitrary caps.

Evidence: FE/cci-host-relief-20261030T215219.json; repeat-20261030T2156.json; fresh-searches.private.json. Current source a5c38c697fdab07aeab90db057424aa73bf0fc39. Native tail task707103f0e1bf7a21abeeccb848226e967daa5e30 remains DONE; existing normal publisher watch5084 is retained separately.

ops.text: Actual same-identity bounded native measurements and passive request/log evidence identify the daemon CPU hot path and smallest supported reproduction; no protected process suspension/signals or local tests.

A source-backed scoped fix removes confirmed unnecessary work, preserves protocol/output/error/mesh behavior, and passes independent review plus meaningful actual-caller CI semantics and operation-count gates.

Merged exact native source and required CI pass; normal signed release is installed and loaded via Root serialized slot; one qualified affected daemon/request check proves improvement with protected sessions/schema14/manifests/channels/subscriptions preserved.
